contexts.text: In returning I will return to thee... () = the conjunction of the Divine with the Human.
To return to them () = to be conjoined.
Let him not return back to take his garment () = let those in good not betake themselves to what is doctrinal.
To return to the land () = to betake himself more nearly to Divine good.
To return to his place () = to return to the previous state.
Return ye to the man () = life from spiritual truth.
I will return () = presence in the natural mind.
Joseph returned to Egypt () = the life of the Celestial Internal in scientifics. To return = to live.
Moses... returned () = what is continuous of the previous life. Explained.
I will return to my brethren () = elevation to more interior and spiritual life. Explained.
[Lest] they return to Egypt () = to lapse into falsities.
Let them return () = that they were not yet prepared.
Let the waters return upon the Egyptians () = the overflowing or relapse of falsity... AC 8226. AC 8229.
Until we return () = even to a reply.
